text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we shall begin the award 
ceremony! Durandal, listen well!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: An award? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Number one! Yesterday, you sprinted at 
full speed to return a handkerchief 
dropped by a child! Good job! Come on, 
Believe, say a word too!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Umm... I think you did great.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—! *cough* I merely did what any knight 
naturally would. It is hardly anything 
worthy of an award.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Number two! The day before yesterday, you 
helped an elderly lady carry her heavy 
bags! Good job! Isn't that right, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That's true... I think that's very 
admirable.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—! No, that was merely my duty as 
expected, hardly anything worthy of an 
award—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I happen to know you were doing 
outrageous things three days ago, four 
days ago, and a week ago!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And that is why you are magnificent, 
Durandal! On this day of your birth, I 
wish to devote all my energy to singing 
your praises!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Um, but... do you think this works as a 
birthday present? I have a cake prepared 
separately, though—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, there's no better present than 
this. I'm so grateful. ...So, um, 
continuing with the commendation... Could 
we have more, or rather, just a little bit 
more?
